_about: ERP pulls behind Business Studio's 7 stock categories. Filters captured from the ERP screen 21/11/2026; rules checked piece by piece against Business Studio's 11 Nov 2026 upload (99% same pieces).

main_rules._about: Rows of the 'main' pull are judged per set (set code, or the barcode of a piece not in a set); the whole set takes the first rule that matches any of its pieces, else stays diamond.
